title: REQ · Focus is removed when the scene shuts down
summary: BootScene shutdown blurs every SceneObject and clears the store focus
description: Context: the SHUTDOWN handler in BootScene.create unsubscribes the store, destroys effects, objects and sprites. Desired behavior: before destroying objects it blurs each one and sets focusedObjectId to null. Expected result: no stale focus survives a scene restart. Why: a remounted scene must not start with a phantom highlight.
acceptance_criteria: Given a focused object, when SHUTDOWN fires, then blur() is called on every SceneObject
Given focusedObjectId is 'bed', when SHUTDOWN fires, then the store focusedObjectId is null
Given SHUTDOWN has fired, when the store focus changes afterwards, then no SceneObject focus or blur call occurs
technical_constraints: Unsubscribe from the store before writing null so the scene is not re-entered
definition_of_done: Shutdown removes scene and store focus
